note: Approvals only. A collection or a record id is added here after an explicit approval by the project owner, or after a documented source comparison made by the AI assistant under the owner's delegation of 2026-10-03 (AGENTS.md section 9). Each entry names who approved and on what evidence. scripts/build-corpus.ts then marks those records reviewed.

collections.scope: Quran collection approved for Azw's text matching. Does not cover search-spelling handling, display of the ۞/۩ signs, or surah alternate names — those decisions stay pending.
collections.method: The owner personally compared the 10 ayat listed in docs/REVIEW_SHEET.md with مصحف المدينة النبوية on 2026-10-02; all 10 matched.
openIssues: Quranpedia manifest sha256 for mushafs-1.json.gz does not match the served file; unresolved, cause not established (docs/SOURCES.md 3.1).

collections.scope: Sahih al-Bukhari collection approved for Azw's text matching. Covers only records with no reported issue. Does not cover records with damaged text, split (decimal) entries, records whose text block the source repeats under several numbers, records whose text does not open with a formula of direct transmission (docs/DECISIONS.md D-5), or the records in data/review/held-records.json — those stay pending.
collections.method: Approved on the automated sample checks; the owner did not compare records with a printed edition by hand. Checks: raw file byte-identical to hadith-api commit df57907; 30 of 30 sampled records confirmed on Dorar by number and matn (docs/SOURCES.md section 4); 12 records compared word for word with Dorar's book text: 12 numbers agree, 8 no word difference, 3 spelling only, 1 real wording difference (bukhari:2075, held) — docs/HADITH_REVIEW_SAMPLE.md, docs/HADITH_FLAGGED_INVESTIGATION.md.
openIssues: The approval rests on a sample (30 + 12 records); the other records were not compared with a second text.
The source repository does not state which printed edition the Arabic text was digitized from.
bukhari:2075 stays held: its last six words are not in the printed text under this number (Dorar and shamela.ws ط السلطانية 3/57 both end at «أحبله»). docs/DECISIONS.md D-14.

collections.method: Approved on the automated sample checks; the owner did not compare records with a printed edition by hand. Checks: raw file byte-identical to hadith-api commit df57907; 30 of 30 sampled records confirmed on Dorar by number and matn (docs/SOURCES.md section 4); 12 records compared with Dorar: 12 numbers agree, 6 no word difference from the book text, 1 spelling only, 5 unresolved and held — docs/HADITH_REVIEW_SAMPLE.md, docs/HADITH_FLAGGED_INVESTIGATION.md.
openIssues: The approval rests on a sample (30 + 12 records); the other records were not compared with a second text.

The 5 records held after the word-for-word sample were compared with a second edition on 2026-10-03 and released (see records): our text agrees with صحيح مسلم ط التركية in all 5; the differences came from one digital copy.
The source repository does not state which printed edition the Arabic text was digitized from.
